about: Worked examples of packing conversions, run by Pest against App\Support\Inventory\Grams and by Vitest against resources/js/lib/grams.ts. Grams are whole numbers everywhere. A weight goes into a Pack as a whole number of packets or not at all: a remainder is refused (packets: null), never rounded, and a refusal names the nearest whole kilograms that Pack does make exactly — the one below and the one above, or the first two where none lies below. Bulk kilograms are whole numbers.

kilograms.name: 2 kg in 500 g packets is 4 packets
2 kg in 250 g packets is 8 packets
1 kg in 100 g packets is 10 packets
3 kg in 1 kg packets is 3 packets
1 kg in 400 g packets is refused, naming 2 kg or 4 kg
3 kg in 400 g packets is refused, naming 2 kg or 4 kg either side of it
5 kg in 400 g packets is refused, naming 4 kg or 6 kg either side of it
1 kg in 300 g packets is refused, naming 3 kg or 6 kg
3 kg in 2 kg packets is refused, naming 2 kg or 4 kg
